description: April McClain Delaney Leads by 15% in Latest Poll GAITHERSBURG, MD — Congresswoman April McClain Delaney continues to hold a significant lead against Republican mega-donor billionaire David Trone in MD-06, according to a recent poll by Hart Research Group.
